function bindStarFallback(canvas): (() => void) | null;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/fallback-stars.ts:111

Binds the fallback canvas: paints immediately and repaints whenever the element resizes (viewport changes, grid step flips). Returns a disposer for teardown — null when the canvas/observer can't run.
